# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Neffi is actively developed. Only the current production version is supported with security fixes. Older snapshots and development branches are not maintained as separate supported versions. This repository does not currently publish a versioned security-support schedule.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Report suspected security vulnerabilities privately through GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting for [iyawnnn/neffi](https://github.com/iyawnnn/neffi).

In the repository, open **Security → Advisories → Report a vulnerability**, or use the [private reporting form](https://github.com/iyawnnn/neffi/security/advisories/new).

**Do not open a public GitHub Issue for security vulnerabilities.** Keep sensitive details out of public discussions, pull requests and comments as well.

Include enough information to help the maintainer understand and reproduce the issue:

- A clear description of the vulnerability and the behavior you observed.
- Reproduction steps when possible, including any necessary account role or setup.
- The potential impact, including what an attacker could access or change.
- Affected routes or features, if known, and when you observed the issue.
- A minimal proof of concept only when it can be shared safely.

Use test accounts and synthetic data wherever possible. Do not include real customer data, secrets, credentials, session cookies or unnecessary personal information. Redact sensitive values from screenshots, logs and request examples before submitting them. If demonstrating the issue would require accessing another person's data or disrupting the service, describe the concern without performing those actions.

## Disclosure

Please avoid publicly disclosing the issue until it has been reviewed and addressed. Keep follow-up details in the private report so the maintainer can investigate, ask clarifying questions and coordinate disclosure with you.
